plan.target: fall5_26w on TradingView BTC.D weekly closes (W-SUN)
plan.rule: when iteration plateaus after exhaustive attempts, look at where the model still fails and add slight nuance dynamics fitted to those conditions, one final pass

candidates.R1: inside condition A (BTC.D >= 15 points below its trailing 104-week high) BTC.D's rise from its trailing 13-week low (points), zero outside; expected negative
candidates.R1b: inside condition A log(1 + weeks since the trailing 104-week high), zero outside; reported beside R1, not adopted on its own
candidates.R2: the five inputs, logistic fit with sample weights 0.5 ** (age_weeks / 156)
candidates.R3: two-parameter logistic recalibration of fixed5's logit on its own earlier out-of-sample predictions with known labels (26-week lag), refit every 13 weeks, active from 52 rows
candidates.R4: inside the fresh-start condition (BTC.D within 3 points of its 13-week high) BTC.D's 8-week change (points), zero outside; expected positive
candidates.R+: the combination of the candidates that pass on their own, evaluated once, only if two or more pass

criteria.i: pooled Brier improvement >= 0.005 with block q05 > 0, and log-loss improvement >= 0.01
criteria.ii: no era (2019-20, 2021-22, 2023-26) worse by more than 0.005 Brier
criteria.iii: inside the target weeks improvement >= 0.01 with q05 > 0; outside no worse than -0.003 (R1, R1b: A; R4: fresh start; R2, R3: A union B)
criteria.iv: real improvement > p95 of the matched placebo (200 draws) AND shifted-label null p < 0.05
criteria.v: no out-of-sample fall week below 2%, pooled AUC does not fall by more than 0.01

plan.verdicts: adopted (all five) | condition note ((iii) and (v) pass but (i) or (iv) fails) | not supported (otherwise, with the failing criterion)

coefficients.fixedPointNote: p* = sigmoid(a / (1 - b)), the probability the map leaves unchanged: with b < 1 it raises every forecast below p* and lowers every forecast above it, so a p* near the base rate is shrinkage toward it and a p* near 0 is a downward level shift
coefficients.expectedSign: b < 1 with a < 0 (the plan's mechanism is overconfidence: shrinkage toward the base rate); b > 0 keeps the ranking within a refit window. Observed: see observedMechanism (computed from the fixed points and the forecasts each map acted on)

observedMechanism.text: a < 0 and b < 1 at every refit; the fixed point p* moved from 0.449 at the first refit (2020-10-04) to 1.67e-05 at the last; from the 2024-03-31 refit on every map lowered every forecast it acted on, a level correction for a falling base rate rather than shrinkage toward the base rate. The ranking is fixed5's only within a refit window: the pooled AUC changes because the map changes between refits (AUC change -0.0066).
observedMechanism.what: labelled diagnostic: shareOfWindowLowered = share of the fixed5 forecasts in each refit window whose logit lies above the map's fixed point (the map lowers them)

designSelection.statement: design-level look-ahead (not a code leak): the plan derived condition A, the B band, R4's fresh-start window and the term choices from fixed5's 2019-2026 out-of-sample failure inventory (out8/honest), and the criteria are scored on the same common rows (2019-04-07..2026-05-03 labelled). Every registered adversary (random-block placebo, permuted ages, shuffled map, 26-week shift null) keeps the condition's definition fixed and none models the choice of that condition from these rows, so a candidate that passed would carry an optimistic (iv) percentile
designSelection.consequence: verdicts: R1 not supported, R1b not supported, R2 not supported, R3 not supported, R4 not supported; the bias favours the candidates, so a 'not supported' stands, and any pass must be confirmed on weeks after 2026-11-01 (forecast_log.csv)

notes: Common rows: every model forecasts from 2019-04-07 (fixed5 needs 60 training rows: ethbtc_fromhi52w is finite from 2017-06 and labels wait 26 weeks); 370 labelled weekly rows (2019-04-07..2026-05-03), 100 positives in 12 label episodes; the last 26 weeks carry no label and enter only 'today' and decision50.

fixed5 = study8_baselines.SIGNALS through study9_candidates.run_spec (study8_common.walk_forward: expanding window, refit every 13 weeks from 2019-01-06, labels withheld 26 weeks, min_train 60; z-scores clipped at 3; logistic lam 1), btc_dd_ath from the full BTCUSD history (study8_honest.ath_drawdown); it reproduces round 9 and round 8 to their 4-digit rounding (leakage.fixed5Reproduction).

R1/R1b/R4 add one column to fixed5 through the same harness; the column is zero outside its condition, but every refit re-estimates the intercept and the five coefficients with it, so the forecasts outside the condition move too (insideOutside.spillover, labelled diagnostic: for R1 the mean |p - p_fixed5| is +0.0220 inside A and +0.0185 outside, outside shift +0.0100). Criterion (iii)'s outside half therefore tests that spillover and is not a free pass for a gated term: the registered placebo draws reach (iii) on their own random gate in R1 0.045, R1b 0.01, R4 0.0 of draws (placebo.ownGateDiagnostic). diagnostics.gateOnly_condA (fixed5 + the bare A indicator, no term values) shows the gate alone: inside +0.0665, outside -0.0737, pooled -0.0328. The harness's clip at 3 standard deviations caps the largest inside values (coefficients.termClipShareLast).

Condition A uses TradingView BTC.D, whose 2016 levels (up to 98.4 on 2016-06-19) hold the trailing 104-week high above 90 into early 2019, so on the panel (from 2016-06-05) condition A runs 2017-04-02..2017-04-02 (1), 2017-05-07..2019-05-05 (105), 2019-06-02..2019-06-09 (2), 2021-04-11..2023-03-12 (101); diagnostics.R1_cmcCondition re-runs R1 with the condition on CoinMarketCap dominance (term unchanged) as a robustness check, not a verdict input.

R1b's expected sign is not registered in the plan (by analogy with R1 it would be negative); R1b is reported beside R1 and is not adopted on its own: if it passed all five its verdict would read 'condition note' with that reason, and it does not count toward R+.

R2's weights are 0.5 ** (age / 156) exactly as registered (age = weeks from the refit date to the training row, at least 27), in the log likelihood of the harness logistic with its lam 1 unchanged; the z-score scaler is unweighted. Because the weights are below 1 the penalty weighs relatively more; diagnostics.R2_weightsNormalized rescales them to mean 1 to separate the two.

R3 is the harness walk-forward over fixed5's own out-of-sample logits: at each fixed5 refit date t the two-parameter map is fitted on the rows s < t - 26 (labels known at t, so s + 26 <= t holds with one week to spare, the harness's lag convention) that carry a fixed5 prediction; min_train 52 makes it active from the first date with 52 such rows (2020-10-04, which is a refit date), fixed5 before that. The map is the harness logistic (lam 1) on the z-scored logit without the clip, so it is strictly monotone whenever b > 0 and the ranking inside each refit window is fixed5's (leakage.r3Ranking). diagnostics.R3_labelKnownAt_s+26<=t and R3_unregularisedMap show the sensitivity to the two implementation choices the plan leaves open; they are labelled diagnostics, not verdict inputs.

R3's mechanism (labelled diagnostics; the registered verdict is unchanged): a < 0 and b < 1 at every refit; the fixed point p* moved from 0.449 at the first refit (2020-10-04) to 1.67e-05 at the last; from the 2024-03-31 refit on every map lowered every forecast it acted on, a level correction for a falling base rate rather than shrinkage toward the base rate. The ranking is fixed5's only within a refit window: the pooled AUC changes because the map changes between refits (AUC change -0.0066). fixed5 over-predicts on the labelled common rows (mean p 0.411 against a realized rate of 0.270; 2023-26: 0.211 against 0.091). A one-parameter intercept shift on R3's own schedule (diagnostics.R3_interceptOnly: no condition, no slope) improves Brier by +0.0187 against R3's +0.0212; R3 minus intercept-only +0.0025 (block [-0.0042, +0.0105]), and under the registered rule that global shift would read 'condition note at most ((iii) and (v) pass, (i) fails; (iv) not run for a variant)', so (iii) on A union B cannot tell a condition-specific nuance from a global level correction. Shrinking toward the training base rate (the label mean of fixed5's training rows at t) gains at most +0.0011 on the fixed grid, against the intercept shift's +0.0187 (lam 0.1 +0.0011, lam 0.2 +0.0005, lam 0.3 -0.0018, lam 0.5 -0.0118; diagnostics.R3_shrinkToTrainingBase_lam*): that base rate sits well above the 2023-26 rate.

Criteria are computed on the labelled common rows with unrounded numbers; improvements are fixed5 minus candidate (positive = better) for Brier and log loss (natural log, p clipped to [1e-6, 1 - 1e-6]). The 26-week circular block bootstrap and the episode bootstrap (blocks = each label episode with its 26-week run-up and the stretches between) use the same draws for every candidate; per-era bands resample inside the era's rows; inside/outside bands resample the whole common series and average the target (or non-target) rows each draw, so the clustering of the target weeks is kept.

Criterion (iii)'s outside test is the registered point estimate (>= -0.003); its block and episode bands are reported beside it (criteria.iii.outsideBlockQ05), and the share of block draws that clear the bar sits inside the noise for several candidates (criteria.iii.outsideShareClearingBar, labelled diagnostic: R1 0.142, R1b 0.001, R2 0.753, R3 0.54, R4 0.4). Outside, R3's log loss changes by +0.0119 while its Brier changes by -0.0034 (criteria.iii.logLossOutside).

B (p > 0.5 with no fall while BTC.D is within 3 points of its 52-week high) is defined with fixed5's own probability and with the outcome: every B week is a false alarm by construction, so any downward shift scores there. A union B is the plan's split and stays the registered (iii) input for R2 and R3. Without the outcome (criteria.iii.outcomeFree, labelled diagnostic; B' = fixed5 p > 0.5 within 3 points of the 52-week high): R3 inside +0.0278 (block q05 -0.0497) on A union B' and +0.0593 (q05 -0.0061) on A alone, (iii) fail / fail: its registered inside significance comes from the 8 outcome-selected B weeks (+0.286 each, 26% of the inside sum), while the 23 weeks with the same outcome-free signature that B leaves out because a fall followed score -0.210 each in the registered 'outside' (insideOutside.bWeekDecomposition). Every R3 variant's outcome-free (iii) status is in implementationSensitivity.outcomeFreeIiiStatus. R2: (iii) fail registered, fail on A union B', fail on A alone. Any condition note for R2 or R3 under the registered split would rest on outcome-selected weeks.

Placebos (criterion iv) run the whole procedure per draw: R1/R1b/R4 keep the raw term at every week (rise from the 13-week low, log weeks since the 104-week high, 8-week change) and replace the condition by random blocks of its own run lengths placed at random among the out-of-sample weeks, and separately among the earlier training weeks so the fitted coefficient never sees the real condition (placebo.oosOnlyDiagnostic keeps the real condition on the training weeks); R2 permutes the ages among the training rows at every refit; R3 shuffles the past predictions in time against their labels at every refit (the map then has no information and pulls toward the base rate, so this placebo is weak by construction: it is beaten whenever the real map keeps fixed5's ranking).

The R1/R1b/R4 placebo is registered with the raw term kept at every week, so its gated weeks carry other term values (placebo.meanTermOnScoredGatedWeeks, labelled diagnostic: R4's chg8 averages +1.75 on the real fresh-start weeks against a median of +0.04 on placebo gates, because fresh3 and chg8 are mechanically linked). placebo.termPreservingDiagnostic shifts the gate and the gated term together (R4: p95 +0.0071, real percentile 72.0; registered p95 +0.0004, percentile 88.0; the registered placebo is the more lenient of the two for R4). Out-of-sample placebo blocks can land in the 26 unlabelled weeks, so some draws score fewer gated weeks than the real condition (placebo.scoredGatedWeeksPerDraw).

Shifted-label null: draws exactly as study8_common.shift_null (circular shift k uniform in [26, n - 26), so at least 26 weeks in either direction), every model (fixed5, R1, R1b, R2, R3 with its map on the shifted fixed5, R4) refitted on the shifted labels and scored on the labelled common rows (the rows the real statistic uses) where the shifted label exists; p = share of draws whose improvement over the shifted fixed5 is at least the real improvement. Under shifted labels fixed5 itself is overconfident without skill, so a recalibration (R3) can gain there too: the null asks whether the real gain exceeds that.

The skeptic's questions: out of sample condition A is one long run (2021-04-11..2023-03-12 (101)) plus shorter runs (2019-04-07..2019-05-05 (5), 2019-06-02..2019-06-09 (2)). The registered episode bootstrap resamples label episodes (each with its 26-week run-up) and the stretches between; the long A run spans several of those blocks, so a draw drops the whole run in 0.0 of draws (conditionRunLOO.episodeBootstrapWithoutLongestRun). conditionRunBootstrap (diagnostic) resamples the runs of target weeks and the stretches between, so a draw drops the whole run as often as its share of the blocks implies (0.345 of draws for R1); conditionRunLOO drops each run in turn; coefficients.signAtRefits and signSettledFrom show when R1's sign settles (2021-04-04; the refits before then are fitted on the 2017-19 A run alone).

R1 is not identified out of sample. Condition A holds one out-of-sample episode (2021-04-11..2023-03-12 (101)) plus 7 weeks in shorter runs (2019-04-07..2019-05-05 (5), 2019-06-02..2019-06-09 (2)). The registered episode bootstrap cannot drop that run: it spans 8 of the 24 episode blocks, so a draw holds none of them with probability 5.9e-05 (0.0 of the draws did); the plan's 'the episode bootstrap must drop it' is met only by conditionRunLOO and conditionRunBootstrap (diagnostics), and the latter's inside band is degenerate with so few runs (q05 +0.0001, q95 +0.0086). Without the run, R1's pooled change is -0.0076. Within the run, the inside gain split by what the refit in force had seen: no week of the run (38 weeks, +0.0182) against part of it (63 weeks, +0.0029) (conditionRunLOO.longestRunBySeen). The term's sign changed between refits with the same A rows in training (2020-01-05 +0.232 to 2020-04-05 -0.018 with 101 A rows in both; 2020-04-05 -0.018 to 2020-07-05 +0.091 with 101 A rows in both; 2021-01-03 +0.119 to 2021-04-04 -0.331 with 101 A rows in both), so only non-A rows entering the fit moved it (coefficients.identification). Inside A the raw term correlates with the label by run as 2017-05-07..2019-05-05 +0.21, 2021-04-11..2023-03-12 +0.51, and the five signals explain 0.354 of its variance, so signMatchesExpected (negative) is a partial effect under collinearity, not support for 'a base built after a big fall means the season is over'. Even a pass would have rested on one episode.

The episode bootstrap counts the 2021-22 post-season regime as several episodes: its short crash-led label episodes cut the 2021-23 A run into 8 of the 24 episode blocks, so the episode band is too narrow for a gain concentrated in that run. R3 draws 82% of its pooled Brier gain from it: episode q05 +0.0008 against the run bootstrap's pooled q05 -0.0188 (leaving the run out: +0.0053); criteria.i.episodeBandDiagnostic shows both, and 'episode q05 > 0' is not support on its own. Criterion (i) uses the block q05 as registered.
Constraint (v): fall weeks are labelled common rows with label 1; the 2% bar is the plan's rounding of 1/51; the AUC change is the pooled point estimate (its block band is in paired.pooled.auc).

Constraint (v) cannot see the last 26 common weeks, whose labels are pending (constraint.pendingStandDown, labelled diagnostic; the registered (v) is unchanged): R2 sits below 2% in 1 of them (2026-09-20..2026-09-20 (1)), today 0.0316 against fixed5's 0.0399; R3 sits below 2% in 11 of them (2026-08-23..2026-11-01 (11)), today 0.0169 against fixed5's 0.0399 (fixed5: 0 pending weeks below 2%). The plan treats the act/stand-down decision as settled and aims this pass at sizing; today R3 reads 0.0169 (stand down) while fixed5 reads 0.0399 (act), so that candidate would flip today's 50:1 decision (constraint.pendingStandDown has the unlabelled weeks behind it).

decision50 counts weekly rows (the plan's 186 were every second week from out8/honest; inventory.planSampleFixed5 reproduces the plan's numbers on those dates: 185 labelled weeks here because out8 kept the provisional week, whose horizon labelled one more sampled week).

Failure B as registered (fixed5 p > 0.5, no fall, BTC.D within 3 points of its 52-week high) holds only Feb-Mar 2025 on the weekly rows; the plan also names Dec 2019 and Feb 2020, where BTC.D sat 3.1-4.0 and 6.6 points below its 52-week high. The registered definition is used everywhere (it reproduces the plan's 7.5% exactly); inventory.bNearMissDiagnostic lists those weeks.

Shifted-label draws score the labelled common rows (never the 26 unlabelled tail weeks, which a rolled label could otherwise reach) where the shifted label exists and every model forecasts: when the rolled 26-week block of unknown labels lands in the first training window, the first refit falls below 60 rows and its 13 weeks carry no forecast in that draw (shiftNull.rowsScoredPerDraw: every draw scores a subset of the real statistic's rows).
R+ combines the candidates whose verdict is 'adopted' (all five criteria) among R1, R2, R3, R4; with fewer than two, candidates.R+ records why it was not evaluated.
Verdicts are 'provisional' when the run used fewer than 50 null draws or fewer than 1000 bootstrap draws (the fast smoke run); only a full run's verdicts are quotable.

Multiple comparisons: five candidates (+ R+ if evaluated) face five criteria each; criterion (iv) carries the family's protection as registered, multipleComparisons adds the family-wise shifted-label null of the best increment and a Bonferroni reading of the shift p-values as diagnostics.

Selection: the conditions, their thresholds and the terms were chosen from fixed5's 2019-2026 out-of-sample failures, the rows scored here (leakage.designSelection), so round 13 has no untouched holdout and (iv) errs in the candidates' favour (its placebos and shift null keep each condition fixed). A 'condition note' requires (iii) and (v) but not (iv), so it carries no multiplicity or adversary protection (verdict.multiplicityProtection; multipleComparisons.conditionNoteRoute gives the share of placebo draws reaching (iii) and (v) on their own gate). Any adopted or condition-noted candidate must be confirmed going forward in forecast_log.csv, on weeks after 2026-11-01.
Nothing here touches the bot; an adopted candidate joins the forecast reading only after the owner reads it.
